verdict.rationale: Trivy is itself an official first-party CLI. It is documented with concrete commands (`trivy image`, `trivy k8s --report summary cluster`) and installable via brew or docker. Community users corroborate that it is very easy to automate and to integrate into CI/CD pipelines. Missing for 10: no evidence of agent-oriented CLI affordances such as documented machine-readable output modes for AI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: very solid tool, very easy to write automation around.
